summary: Backend-only verification of the startup TipJarHQ showcase seed (option A). All 9 targeted pytest checks passed against the preview URL; MongoDB-level counts additionally confirm exactly one document per seeded id (no duplicates after multiple restarts).
critical_code_review_comments: seed_showcase() is correctly idempotent: guards on {email} for the HQ user and on {id: 'seed-portugal-messi'|'seed-hacken-parlay'} for the tips. DB-level counts verified: 1/1/1.
German characters (Häcken, Djurgården, Über) round-trip cleanly through the API response — encoding is fine.
Regression: create_tip still returns HTTP 400 with the German-flavoured 'match date & time' guard message when match_time is empty; a normal payload with match_time succeeds.
HQ_PASSWORD env override is respected — default 'TipJarHQ2026!' authenticates successfully and returns a JWT token.
Image pipeline works end-to-end: seed_assets/portugal_messi.jpg was uploaded to storage on startup and is now served via GET /api/files/{path} as image/jpeg with a non-empty body.

Minor observation (not blocking): seed_showcase() catches image upload failure and still inserts the tip with image_path=None. That is the correct fail-open behaviour, but if the assets file is ever missing on deploy, the Portugal & Messi tip will silently render without a photo. Consider logging.warning at Sentry level so ops can spot it.
